content.title: Coachella weekend 2 is sold out, here’s how fans can still get 2026 tickets in time
content.text: If you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Mallory Dwortz | mdwortz@mlive.comWith the first sold-out Coachella 2026 weekend underway (April 10), tickets to the second batch of dates are now only available on resale markets.Coachella 2026 is set to begin Friday, April 10 at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California. Located in the Coachella Valley, the annual two-weekend event features nonstop music and art installations running from Thursday arrivals through each Sunday night finale.Who is performing?Coachella 2026 features a lineup of over 130 artists, including headliners Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, and Karol G — alongside The Strokes, Young Thug, Kaskade, FKA Twigs, The xx, Labrinth, Teddy Swims, Turnstile, Ethel Cain, Giveon, Rezz, Iggy Pop, Addison Rae, Nine Inch Nails, Blood Orange, Foster the People, PinkPantheress, and more.When is Coachella weekend 2?The same slate of big-name artists return to the festival grounds next Friday, April 17 for the next round of performances. Coachella 2026 concludes Sunday, April 19.Can I still get tickets?While official 2026 wristbands are sold out, fans can still find single and three-day tickets available via secondary sellers like Vivid Seats, SeatGeek, StubHub, and Ticketmaster. Verified offers are also available on AXS.
